summary: Define inert validation helpers for a revisioned two-device normal iOS update policy and revoked policy digests.

replay.detail: No event replay change; the helpers perform no I/O and have no active caller.

schema.detail: No database schema change; the policy envelope is an unconnected Python data contract.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination rules change.

compatibility.detail: No daemon, app, client or wire change; existing delivery behavior is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service or device interruption; no installation, launch or scheduler is activated.

manual.detail: No operator steps are required. Policy activation and native decision authentication remain outside this change.

recovery.detail: No recovery change; revoked digest parsing is pure and does not read or modify a deny file.
